versions.name: Lifesaving
versions.description: Reach, throw, row, and go: rescue a struggling swimmer with poles, ring buoys, and tows, break free of a panicked grasp, support a suspected spinal injury, and show CPR on a mannequin.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
